subject: general
question: In which of the following cities is the museum named Virasat-e-Khalsa located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anandpur Sahib.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the holy city of** Anandpur Sahib**, close to Chandigarh, the capital of the Indian state of Punjab, is the museum of **Sikhism known as Virasat-e-Khalsa.**
 
• The** museum provides information on the historical** occasions that occurred in Punjab five hundred years ago and gave rise to Sikhism and ultimately the **Khalsa Panth.**
 
• There is an **auditorium with 400 seats located in the western area**. It contains a sizable exhibition space and a library that houses all Sikhism-related journals, publications, books, and **periodicals.**
 
• The **north wing of the eastern complex** is sometimes referred to as the "flower building." 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​The city of** Nanded is located in the Indian state of Maharashtra**. It is the tenth largest city in the state and the 79th most populous city in all of India. In the Marathwada region, it is the **second-largest city.** 
 
• **India's Himachal Pradesh region includes** the industrial town of **Paonta Sahib. **On National Highway 72, it is situated south of Sirmaur district. Sikhs consider** Paonta Sahib** to be a significant location of devotion since it is home to the sizable Gurudwara Paonta Sahib on the Yamuna River's **banks. **
 
• 28 kilometres from Pakistan's border, in the northwest Indian province of Punjab, sits the city of** Amritsar.** The holiest gurdwara (religious complex) in the Sikh religion is the gilded Golden Temple (Harmandir Sahib), which is located in the** middle of its walled ancient town.**
